title: Add onboarding schema mapper and changelog template generator
author: Asha Nair
description: Motivation: onboarding customers and open-source contributors submit model metadata in many shapes (legacy vendor keys, ad-hoc tags, nested provenance blobs). We need a resilient pipeline that canonicalizes incoming metadata into the registry schema, deduplicates repeated fields, and produces human-readable release notes automatically from delta detection and sampled telemetry. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a schema-mapper library (python) that defines mapping rules, alias resolution, and migration hooks to transform legacy uploads into the canonical model registry schema; 2) a changelog template generator that consumes the mapping delta, sampled performance/latency histograms, and curated notes to auto-draft a concise release blurb and a structured changelog entry suitable for the Console and release artifacts. Key points: - Mapping rules are declarative YAML with builtin transforms (rename, flatten, coalesce, type-cast, provenance-extract). - Alias resolution supports mapping multiple vendor-specific keys to a single canonical field and emits a provenance trace showing applied rules. - A migration runner (cli: registry-migrate --preview / --apply) can simulate changes and produce a dry-run report for staging. - Changelog generator picks representative metrics (p50/p95 latency, token throughput delta, embedding cosine baseline) from sampled telemetry, applies heuristics (ignore noise below configured thresholds), and builds a short blurb plus bullet changelog items. - Backfill job to reconcile existing model entries with minimal locking; backfill is batched and idempotent. Compatibility and safety: - Mapping operates with a versioned mapping manifest (v1) and writes an apply_stamp to models so downstream services can detect schema version. - Changes are opt-in by default for Private installs (flag: enable_automap) and turned on for hosted in rolling canary per rollout plan. Migration guidance and rollback: - A preview mode outputs a per-model diff and provenance trace. Backfill can be limited by tags or created_at windows. - Rollback is handled by restore from snapshot (created automatically when running --apply) or by re-applying a reverse transform manifest. Testing and CI: unit tests for transform primitives, integration test against sample legacy payloads, and end-to-end smoke test for changelog generation with synthetic telemetry. Observability: added metrics for mappings_applied, mapping_failures, and changelog_autodrafts_emitted. Docs: operator docs and onboarding guide updated with examples and CLI usage. This description contains implementation notes, migration steps, and testing summary.

release_notes: Introduce a declarative onboarding schema mapper to canonicalize legacy and vendor model metadata.
Add automated changelog template generation that drafts release blurbs using mapping deltas and sampled telemetry.
Add a previewable migration CLI and a batched idempotent backfill job for reconciling existing registry entries.
Operator docs and migration playbook included.
